alerts.description: Raw or normalized security alert records from entity SOC tooling.

fields.alert_id: Primary unique key for the alert event.
fields.cse_id: Submitting Critical Sector Entity unique code.
fields.created_at: UTC ISO-8601 timestamp when detection occurred.
fields.acknowledged_at: Timestamp when analyst opened or acknowledged the alert.
fields.closed_at: Timestamp when alert reached final disposition.
fields.severity: Threat severity rating: Critical, High, Medium, or Low.
fields.alert_category: Taxonomy tag: Malware, Identity, Lateral Movement, Data Exfiltration, etc.
fields.source_system: Detection engine: EDR, NDR, SIEM, Firewall, IAM.
fields.asset_id: Target system identifier from asset inventory.
fields.status: Operational state: Open, Acknowledged, Investigated, Closed, Escalated.
fields.disposition: Analytical resolution: True Positive, False Positive, Benign, Duplicate.

cases.description: Incident investigations opened from one or more alerts.

fields.cse_id: Submitting Critical Sector Entity unique code.
fields.created_at: Timestamp when case was formally instantiated.
fields.closed_at: Timestamp when case was formally closed.
fields.investigation_summary: Narrative notes written by the investigating analyst.
fields.evidence_count: Count of forensic artifacts attached to the investigation.
fields.root_cause: Documented underlying vulnerability or failure vector.

assets.description: Declared inventory of critical systems, networks, and controllers.

fields.criticality: Business impact tier: Critical, High, Medium, Low.
fields.monitoring_expected: Boolean indicating whether SOC is mandated to collect telemetry.
